request: Pull UK street-level crime records from the Home Office's data.police.uk open data API for a Central London polygon (Westminster / City of London / Southwark), previous complete calendar month. One row per crime. The API returns nested location (latitude/longitude/street.name) and outcome_status (category/date); we flatten those with dotted_path derived columns. Enrich with crime_severity_band (map_values on category: violent-crime/robbery/possession-of-weapons->high, burglary/drugs/vehicle-crime/theft-from-the-person->medium, other -> low), outcome_stage (map_values on outcome_status.category: awaiting/court/complete/no-action) and neighborhood_area (map_values on location.street.name prefix -> Westminster / City / Southwark / Other). Publish to 'Prep Agent / 32 - UK Police Street Crime (London)' on Tableau Server for UK MoJ / Home Office / GLA analysts. data.police.uk is a keyless, rate-friendly open-data API (Home Office).

sources.name: UK Police Street Crime (Central London)
sources.description: data.police.uk /api/crimes-street/all-crime endpoint, polygon-filtered to Central London (roughly Westminster + City + Southwark + Lambeth: approx 51.485-51.525N, 0.130W-0.070E). One row per crime; ~2k rows/month for that poly. Nested `location.latitude` / `location.longitude` / `location.street.name` and `outcome_status.category` / `outcome_status.date` are flattened via dotted_path. Keyless.

args.name: UK Police London Crime Trend
args.features_description: Row-level UK street-level crimes for a Central London polygon (Westminster / City / Southwark / Lambeth). Fields: id, persistent_id, category (Home Office standard: violent-crime, robbery, burglary, drugs, etc.), crime_severity_band (high/medium/low), month (YYYY-MM), location_type, location_subtype, latitude, longitude, street_id, street_name, outcome_category (raw Home Office outcome text), outcome_month, outcome_stage (mapped: awaiting_court, no_suspect, custodial, caution, etc.), context.
args.stats_description: Long-form UK police crime statistics (one row per dimension x value x year x month over category, crime_severity_band, outcome_stage). 30-day rolling counts, z-anomalies vs baseline. Use to spot month-over-month spikes in specific offence types or shifts in outcome mix.

outputs.name: UK Police London Crime Detail
outputs.description: Row-level UK street-level crime records for a Central London polygon (Westminster / City / Southwark / Lambeth), previous complete calendar month. Fields: id, persistent_id, category (Home Office standard), crime_severity_band (high/medium/low), month (YYYY-MM), location_type, location_subtype, latitude, longitude, street_id, street_name (Home Office anonymised 'On or near X'), outcome_category (raw Home Office outcome text), outcome_month, outcome_stage (mapped: awaiting_court / no_suspect / custodial / caution / penalty_notice / community_sentence / etc.), context. Source: data.police.uk. Enrichments: crime_severity_band, outcome_stage. Refresh: monthly.

outputs.name: UK Police London Crime Stats
outputs.description: Long-form Central London crime statistics (dimension x value x year x month) over category, crime_severity_band, outcome_stage. Rolling 30-day counts, z-anomalies vs lifetime baseline (|z|>=2.0 flagged is_anomaly=True). Joinable from Tableau on (dimension, value, year, month).
